title: runstate v0.4 subscription convention
description: Pins the bodies of the control.* topics an orchestrator produces (log format 0.4.0; docs/specs/commits-and-lineage.md section 3): control.subscribe and control.stop carry a Schedule / StopTrigger over the condition-algebra; control.withdraw (new) carries {t} and cancels by request_id, replacing the retired control.unsubscribe. Every control record's request_id is required and non-null (a subscription's id, a stop's id, or on withdraw the id of the request withdrawn). control.subscribe's envelope name is the source it targets, or null for pure demand; control.stop and control.withdraw carry name null. Atoms: {stream, n} and {commits: n} (n from 0 to 2^53-1) replace the removed {step: N}; time_seconds, count, any and all are unchanged; count only in `until`. Applied on top of the envelope schema. CONSTRAINTS THE SCHEMA CANNOT CHECK, each answered by a nak rather than refused on the wire: a pure demand (name null) takes only an `until`, and a from, an every or a {count: n} atom in it is refused with reason malformed; a re-send of a live id may replace its schedule but not its target or class (lease or durable), else malformed; a subscription targeting a name the claim does not declare a source, a progress atom naming a source, and an empty window (a from that implies the until) are refused with reason unsatisfiable. Whether a {stream} atom names an eager stream is a fact of the claim's declaration, not of the body.

allOf.comment: Every control verb is correlated by request_id, so it MUST be present (a non-null string).

Withdraw.description: control.withdraw cancels the request its envelope request_id names (a stop or a subscription). t is the asker's wall-clock.

StopTrigger.description: control.stop is one-shot: it carries at most a `from`. No `every`/`until`.

Schedule.description: from/every/until, each a Condition. Absent `every` => one-shot. `count` thresholds are valid only in `until`.

StreamThreshold.description: The count of elements of the named eager stream on the lineage reaches n.

CommitsThreshold.description: The lineage's own clock: iterations committed.

CountThreshold.description: A subscription's fire budget; only in `until`.

Condition.description: Threshold over (stream, commits, time) or any/all of Conditions. No `count` here.

UntilCondition.description: The `until` slot's grammar: as Condition, plus `count` thresholds.
